dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You look annoyed, Nam. What happened?
dialogue.reading: juː ˈlʊk əˈnɔɪd, ˈnɑːm. ˈwʌt ˈhæpənd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I had a terrible afternoon. I was supposed to meet my cousin Kwan at a café at two.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhæd ə ˈtɛrəbəl ˌæftərˈnuːn. aɪ wʌz səˈpoʊst tə ˈmiːt maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈkwɑːn ət ə kæˈfeɪ ət ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No! I had been waiting patiently for an hour when she called me.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ! aɪ hæd bɪn ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈpeɪʃəntli fər ən ˈaʊər wɛn ʃiː ˈkɔːld miː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was. I had been sitting there for so long that the waiter kept asking me if I wanted another drink.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwʌz. aɪ hæd bɪn ˈsɪtɪŋ ðɛr fər soʊ ˈlɔːŋ ðæt ðə ˈweɪtər ˈkɛpt ˈæskɪŋ miː ɪf aɪ ˈwɑːntɪd əˈnʌðər ˈdrɪŋk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She had been waiting for me at a different café with the same name!
dialogue.reading: ʃiː hæd bɪn ˈweɪtɪŋ fər miː ət ə ˈdɪfərənt kæˈfeɪ wɪð ðə ˈseɪm ˈneɪm!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! So you were both waiting.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! soʊ juː wɜːr ˈboʊθ ˈweɪtɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. We had both been sitting there, getting more and more fed up.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. wiː hæd ˈboʊθ bɪn ˈsɪtɪŋ ðɛr, ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈmɔːr ənd ˈmɔːr ˈfɛd ˈʌp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Were you still angry with her?
dialogue.reading: wɜːr juː ˈstɪl ˈæŋɡri wɪð hɜːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: For a minute. Then we both started laughing.
dialogue.reading: fər ə ˈmɪnɪt. ˈðɛn wiː ˈboʊθ ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈlæfɪŋ.
